subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review - scheduling
messages:
From: Sam Harrington <sam.harrington@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity review - request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Marissa + Laura,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at Acme AI is excited about Redwood Dedicated. We're at the point where we need a technical deep-dive to lock down pool sizing, autoscaling behavior, and isolation guarantees before we finalize our procurement timeline.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review next week? Key goals:
- Walk through how pool sizing maps to throughput/latency for our expected 100k tokens/day workload
- Autoscaling policies and typical scale-up/down times under sustained bursts
- Isolation controls (tenant separation, noisy-neighbor mitigations, dedicated v. burst capacity)

Attaching a high-level traffic summary and our current infra constraints. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Harrington
Head of Infrastructure
Acme AI

Attachment: acme-traffic-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Harrington <sam.harrington@acmeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity review - request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Sam — glad to hear the demo landed well. We'd love to run the deep-dive. Laura, David and Rishi will be the core technical leads on our side.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-06-30 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-07-01 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-07-02 08:30–10:00 (if you need an earlier slot)

Agenda we propose:
1) Quick recap of Acme constraints (5 min)
2) Serving runtime overview and pooling model (20 min)
3) Autoscaling mechanics, latency implications, and guardrails (25 min)
4) Isolation, security controls, and failure modes (20 min)
5) Q&A and next steps (10–20 min)

I'll attach our draft capacity plan and a reference architecture diagram to help guide the discussion. If you have a concrete request (e.g., target 99th percentile latency at X tokens/s) add it here and we'll tune the plan before the call.

Best,
Marissa
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-capacity-plan.xlsx (xlsx), draft-architecture-diagram.png (png)

From: Sam Harrington <sam.harrington@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acmeai.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity review - request for architecture deep-dive

Marissa — Tue 6/30 09:00 PT works for us. Primary attendees: myself, our platform lead (ops@acmeai.com), and one ML infra engineer. We'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Two asks to prep:
1) If you can include any empirical latency-by-batch-size numbers for the 70B family or a nearest comparable model, that would help.
2) Example canary/circuit-breaker configs you recommend for early rollouts.

Thanks,
Sam

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Harrington <sam.harrington@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity review - request for architecture deep-dive

Thanks Sam — we'll bring the measurements and canary examples. Quick internal note for the team:
- David: can you pull 70B latency-by-batch-size snapshots from the benchmarking bucket and add to the plan?
- Rishi: please draft a recommended autoscale policy (scale thresholds, cooldown, max-burst) we can present.
- Priya: include isolation matrix (tenant network/IO limits, resource reservation).

I'll assemble the slides and send a calendar invite for Tue 6/30 09:00 PT after Marissa confirms.

Laura
Sr Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
